## X-Sense Home Security v1.6.7-10

- Reduce unnecessary MQTT entity writes from SBS50 arm-mode, intrusion, connection, and child reports while preserving alarm events and control recovery (#447).
- Reduce repeated work when processing MQTT reports and restoring subscriptions after reconnects (#447).
- With X-Sense debug logging enabled, slow Home Assistant sensor writes now record elapsed time, thread CPU time, and any stack samples captured during the write. The diagnostics retain the slowest write and the slowest write with a stack separately. This helps investigate the reported stall; it does not confirm a fix for it (#447).
